title: Authentic and simulated project-based learning to improve students’ employability skills and their translator competence
core_idea: Compare the effectiveness of authentic versus simulated project-based learning (PjBL) for translation students by assessing impacts on employability skills and translator competence using a mixed-methods design (documentary analysis and self-report questionnaires), and to identify which translator competences improve most and how PjBL can bridge university curriculum and industry practice.
tldr: A mixed-method study designed to compare authentic and simulated PjBL in translation education, measuring effects on students' employability skills and translator competences and aiming to identify most-improved competences and offer a curriculum–industry bridging model.
